facts.text: Cadogan lies along the Allegheny River and PA Route 128, just 5.3 miles southwest of Kittanning.
Cadogan is part of Cadogan Township in Armstrong County, an area that boasts 15 historic sites including museums and preserved landmarks.
The county’s outdoor scene features over 200 miles of trails, the Allegheny River, and fishing spots, making it a hub for hiking, biking, and paddling.
Armstrong County hosts festivals, live music, food and wine tastings, and arts and crafts, creating a vibrant cultural calendar.
French Azilum Historic Site, nearby, offers wellness days and hands‑on history experiences like blacksmithing.
Cadogan’s unincorporated status means it relies on township governance, a common arrangement in rural Pennsylvania.
